sources.text: प्रकाशसंश्लेषण (Photosynthesis) ही वनस्पतींची अशी प्रक्रिया आहे ज्यामध्ये सूर्यप्रकाश, पाणी आणि कार्बन डायऑक्साईडचा वापर करून अन्न तयार केले जाते आणि ऑक्सिजन सोडला जातो.

sources.text: A photon is an elementary particle, the quantum of all forms of electromagnetic radiation including light. It is the force carrier for electromagnetic force, even when static via virtual photons.

sources.text: In physics, a photon is usually denoted by the symbol Î³ (the Greek letter gamma). This symbol for the photon probably derives from gamma rays, which were discovered in 1900 by Paul Villard, named by Ernest Rutherford in 1903, and shown to be a form of electromagnetic radiation in 1914 by Rutherford and Edward Andrade.
